paragraphs.text: Wilt-Leaf Wood is the sickly counterpart of the lush Gilt-Leaf Wood after Lorwyn's transformation into Shadowmoor through the Great Aurora .
Located across the Wanderbrine from Mistmeadow in the heart of the forest, the capital of the Wilt-Leaf Wood is the safehold of Cayr Ulios .

After the last Great Aurora , Wilt-Leaf Wood was home to several elven safeholds . One of them, Trendan 's Safehold , was destroyed in a boggart raid that turned into a massacre, with all the refuge's defenders slain, including both of Valya 's parents.
